snippet.title: When Sirens Fall Silent - Act 3 Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

In early-1990s Italy, policewoman Mila is pulled into a high-profile case of kidnappings and murders. This psychological thriller comes from LKA, the studio behind The Town of Light and Martha Is Dead, and deals with trauma, addiction, misogyny and human trafficking.
